name: Site registry host adapter
description: Host side of the site-registry retrieval flow: plugin.getConfig (keys site_registry_enabled, site_registry_producer_peer_id, site_registry_source with access anonymous) and the run's start time and producer, read once when the timer fires so every stage of a run cites the same time. Parsing, the rules and the records stay in the portable module.

sequentialJustification.detail: One configuration read per timer tick; the host owns I/O. No threads.
